briefdescription.para: The ModuleStructure that this ClassLoader is responsible for loading as Java classes.

detaileddescription.para: '-delimited package name assigned to this loader to load all of its classes within.

'-delimited package prefix (as used in the JVM ClassFile Specification) assigned to this loader to create all of its class names beginning with. The prefix will always end with a '.' character. This is the same name as pkg.

briefdescription.para: The TypeSystem that this ModuleLoader is working on behalf of, and which does the Java ClassFile generation for the module that this ModuleLoader is responsible for loading.

detaileddescription.para: Since modules can be dependent on other modules within the same TypeSystem, the parent ClassLoader is always the TypeSystemLoader responsible for introducing (bringing into existence) the module.

parameterdescription.para: the '.'-delimited Java package name assigned to this loader and corresponding to the module, which in theory this loader will "own" responsibility for loading all classes under that package, and nothing outside of that package
the TypeSystemLoader within which the module is being loaded
the ModuleStructure that this loader is responsible for loading
a String resulting from the ClassFile API

simplesect.para: a more readable String (sans slash-u encodings)

briefdescription.para: A ModuleLoader is responsible for loading exactly one module with a specified set of attributes such as the module version, the absence/presence of other modules, and a set of defined (or explicitly undefined) names.
